part.text: Fixed. The top-level `Tokenizer.withMetadata` now accepts varargs `(String, Any)*` in addition to a `Map`, so both `Tokenizer.withMetadata(token, "type" -> "custom")` and `Tokenizer.withMetadata(token, Map(...))` work.
